relevance_note: The paper describes one patient with a TNFAIP3 deletion with individual-level features: "heterozygous deletion of TNFAIP3 in patient-191 is another conclusive molecular diagnosis" and "Clinical manifestations observed in the carrier include rosacea, lymphadenopathy...".
method_note: Read by hand; the JSON was assembled with a short Python script from values chosen while reading. CNV-detection cohort of 191 patients with suspected IEI; only patient-191 (heterozygous 59.9 kb TNFAIP3 deletion) is in scope; all other patients carry CNVs/SNVs in other genes and get no rows. Table 1 is present only as a title and notes (no rows converted), and supplementary Tab.S1 and Tab.S2 (clinical phenotypes) are images only, so per-patient sex, age and further phenotypes for patient-191 could not be read. No HGVS, transcript or coordinates are printed for the deletion; variant_original_string is the size description. 'This CNV as pathogenic' is stated for patient-191's deletion specifically. parental_testing_statement uses a study-wide limitation sentence implying parents were not analysed; inheritance left not reported. is_proband left null (cohort paper; no proband wording). Checklist: rosacea recorded as observed for the composite 'skin lesions' item (judgment call); chronic sinusitis not counted as 'recurrent infections' and pulmonary emphysema not counted as 'interstitial lung disease'. cites_prior_report is true because patient-005 (ICOS, out of scope) was reported in [23]. Rosacea HPO ID left null (not sure). No contradictions found. Stacked cells: none present.
